title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 228 (Investigation, etc., of foreign companies)

content.overview: Section 228 provides that the provisions of this Chapter shall apply mutatis mutandis to foreign companies subject to such exceptions, modifications and adaptations as may be made therein by rules made under this Act. Ownership investigation of Indian companies is under section 216; this section extends the investigation chapter’s machinery to foreign companies as adapted by rules.
content.glance: Chapter XIV applies mutatis mutandis to foreign companies, subject to exceptions/modifications/adaptations by rules; distinct from s. 216 ownership investigation of Indian companies.
content.study: The provisions of this Chapter shall apply mutatis mutandis to foreign companies subject to such exceptions, modifications and adaptations as may be made therein by rules made under this Act. Current-law framing: identify a foreign company within the meaning of the Act; apply Chapter XIV investigation machinery with necessary changes; check any rules that except, modify or adapt particular provisions. Do not treat this section as a duplicate of s. 216 (investigation of ownership of an Indian company).

sections.heading: Distinction from s. 216
sections.body: Section 216 is ownership investigation of a company; section 228 extends the chapter’s framework to foreign companies.

examples.title: Foreign company investigation
examples.body: The Central Government seeks to investigate the affairs of a foreign company that has a place of business in India. Under s. 228, Chapter XIV applies mutatis mutandis, subject to any rules adapting the provisions.

examples.title: Not a second ownership section
examples.body: Section 228 is not a second ownership-investigation power parallel to s. 216. It extends the chapter’s investigation machinery to foreign companies with necessary adaptations.

hypotheticals.question: Is s. 228 the same as investigating ownership under s. 216?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 216 is the power to investigate membership and true controllers of a company. Section 228 provides that Chapter XIV applies mutatis mutandis to foreign companies, subject to rules. The legacy scaffold that labelled s. 228 as ownership investigation was incorrect.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 228 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify foreign company. II. Apply Chapter XIV mutatis mutandis. III. Check rules for adaptations. IV. Distinguish s. 216. V. Conclude.
